scientific_integrity: A complete proof and an exact finite checker are provided. Classical Baker–Wüstholz logarithmic-form bounds and Erdős–Turán discrepancy are stated as external mathematical inputs. No independent review or novel named theorem provenance is fabricated.
scientific_limitations: The result gives exponential order only under one simple dominant root and multiplicative independence; constants may be huge, and independent validation is outstanding. The finite verifier does not prove the theorem.
title: Exponential bounds for the shortest digit-appending step in an algebraic recurrence
